props.label: About Western NX
props.heading: Imported fashion, priced for Nagpur
props.body:
Western NX is a women's fashion store at Jaripatka Main Market, Nagpur.

We bring in imported Korean and co-ord fabrics — night suits, cord sets, denim, tees and ethnic wear — and price them so you can buy two instead of one. Sizes run M to 3XL across most ranges, and new designs land every week.

Come to the shop, or message us on WhatsApp and we will send photographs of what is in stock today. We ship across India, and we supply wholesale to boutiques and resellers.
